rows.ARS:
Pink blend Hybrid Tea.
Exhibition name: Augusta Luise ® (Hybrid Tea, Evers, 1999)
rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 1999).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 1999 as 'Augusta Luise'.
Introduced in United Kingdom by Pocock's Nurseries/Pocock's Roses in 2002 as 'Rachel'.
rows.Bloom: Peach and light yellow, ages to salmon-pink . Strong, fruity, sweet fragrance. up to 50 petals. Average diameter 6". Very large, very full (41+ petals), borne mostly solitary, old-fashioned bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium. Glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 28" to 5' (70 to 150cm). Width: up to 5' (up to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 6b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, container rose, cut flower or garden. Vigorous. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Rosen-Tantau says the correct name for this rose is Augusta Luise® (TANgust).
Trademark listing of Tantau says a synonym is TANellqua (= Aquarell)

colour: Peach and light yellow, ages to salmon-pink .
